title: AntiNBTKick
body:
Stops NBT Kicking on 26.x+

Prevents Invaild NBT Tags Kicking the player, mainly from ViaVersion.

Tested on 1.21.11 Paper Server with a 26.1 Fabric Client.

note: this is because 1.21.x allows non vanilla tags in the /give command, and 26.x doesnt like them.


any NBT kicks i find ill add preventions to this mod.
report any bugs on the discord
